title: epan: Have tvb_reported_length_remaining return unsigned
description:
For some dissectors, cast values appropriately. For others, stop
casting or retrieve and store length values that are unsigned as
unsigned.

In a few places, change comparison tests that don't work with unsigned.

Ping #20103

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 9451d061 - epan: Have tvb_reported_length_remaining return unsigned
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23286/diffs?diff_id=1631623085&start_sha=44511dbed7f25caf793ee5ead58d23ddbb713bdc)

Yeah, most compilers even when warning about sign comparisons will let you compare an unsigned variable with a constant literal even if you don't put the U suffix, but MSVC apparently complains if both of the right hand side of a ternary are literal integers.

There is a more paranoid ridiculous warning option that makes GCC complain too.

              * there is an SMB header there ...
              */
-            if( ((int)plen>tvb_reported_length_remaining(tvb, offset))
+            if( (plen>tvb_reported_length_remaining(tvb, offset))

                 &&(tvb_get_uint8(tvb,offset+6) == 'M')
